</pre></div>
</div>
<div class="nb-cell"><div class="codehilite lang-nb"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pandas</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pd</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">matplotlib.pyplot</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">plt</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">seaborn</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sns</span>

<span class="c1"># 设置中文字体支持</span>
<span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">rcParams</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update</span><span class="p">({</span>
    <span class="s2">"font.sans-serif"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"PingFang SC"</span><span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="s2">"axes.unicode_minus"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s2">"figure.dpi"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">100</span>
<span class="p">})</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">reset</span><span class="p">():</span>
    <span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">close</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"all"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Seaborn 全局样式</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set_theme</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">style</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"whitegrid"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">font</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"PingFang SC"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">df</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read_csv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"../linking_clean.csv"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">head</span><span class="p">()</span>

<span class="n">df_clean</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dropna</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subset</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<h1 id="用-Seaborn-分析前端开发者薪资数据">用 Seaborn 分析前端开发者薪资数据</h1>
<p>本节课通过分析一份前端开发者的薪资调研数据，一边做分析一边熟悉 <strong>Seaborn</strong>。</p>
<p>Seaborn 是建立在 Matplotlib 之上的高级统计可视化库，
特点是<strong>用简洁的代码就能生成美观且有统计意义的图表</strong>。</p>
<p><strong>本节课目标</strong>：掌握 Seaborn 的核心图类型——分布图、箱线图、散点图、
回归图、分类汇总图、热力图等，并能结合实际数据做探索性分析。</p>
<hr />
<h2 id="1-薪资分布-单变量分析">1. 薪资分布 — 单变量分析</h2>
<p>先用 <code>histplot</code> 和 <code>kdeplot</code> 看薪资的整体分布形态。</p>
<p><code>histplot</code> — 直方图，展示数据在各区间的频次。</p>
<p><code>kdeplot</code> — 核密度估计，平滑地展示概率密度。</p>
<div class="nb-cell"><div class="codehilite lang-nb"><pre><span></span><span class="n">reset</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">fig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subplots</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">figsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="c1"># 直方图</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">histplot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bins</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">30</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set_title</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"薪资直方图"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># 核密度估计</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">kdeplot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fill</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set_title</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"薪资核密度估计"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># ax = axes[0]</span>
<span class="c1"># for patch in ax.patches:</span>
<span class="c1">#     height = patch.get_height()</span>
<span class="c1">#     if height &gt; 0:  # 避免标注空柱子</span>
<span class="c1">#         ax.text(</span>
<span class="c1">#             patch.get_x() + patch.get_width()/2,  # X 坐标：柱子中间</span>
<span class="c1">#             height,                               # Y 坐标：柱子顶部</span>
<span class="c1">#             f'{int(height)}',                     # 显示内容</span>
<span class="c1">#             ha='center', va='bottom',             # 水平居中，垂直在底部上方</span>
<span class="c1">#             fontsize=8</span>
<span class="c1">#         )</span>

<span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tight_layout</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
<div class="nb-out"><img class="nb-img" src="data:image/png;base64," loading="lazy" /></div></div>
<div class="nb-cell"><div class="codehilite lang-nb"><pre><span></span><span class="n">reset</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">displot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="n">kde</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bins</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">30</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
<div class="nb-out"><pre class="nb-result">&lt;seaborn.axisgrid.FacetGrid at 0x131ca8ec0&gt;</pre><img class="nb-img" src="data:image/png;base64," loading="lazy" /></div></div>
<hr />
<h2 id="2-学历与薪资-分类对比">2. 学历与薪资 — 分类对比</h2>
<p>用 <code>boxplot</code> 和 <code>violinplot</code> 对比不同学历的薪资分布。</p>
<p><code>boxplot</code> — 箱线图，展示中位数、四分位数、异常值。</p>
<p><code>violinplot</code> — 小提琴图，在箱线图基础上叠加了分布形状。</p>
<div class="nb-cell"><div class="codehilite lang-nb"><pre><span></span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'学历'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">value_counts</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
<div class="nb-out"><pre class="nb-result">学历
本科    387
大专    210
硕士     36
高中     23
初中     12
中专      4
小学      1
Name: count, dtype: int64</pre></div></div>
<div class="nb-cell"><div class="codehilite lang-nb"><pre><span></span><span class="n">reset</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">fig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subplots</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">figsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="c1"># 箱线图</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">boxplot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"学历"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">order</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"小学"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"中专"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"初中"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"高中"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"大专"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"本科"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"硕士"</span><span class="p">],</span> 
            <span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set_title</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"学历 vs 薪资 — 箱线图"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># 小提琴图</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">violinplot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"学历"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span>
               <span class="n">order</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"小学"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"中专"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"初中"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"高中"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"大专"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"本科"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"硕士"</span><span class="p">],</span> 
               <span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set_title</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"学历 vs 薪资 — 小提琴图"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">fig</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tight_layout</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
<div class="nb-out"><img class="nb-img" src="data:image/png;base64," loading="lazy" /></div></div>
<div class="nb-cell"><div class="codehilite lang-nb"><pre><span></span><span class="n">reset</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="c1"># barplot 默认显示均值 + 置信区间</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">barplot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"学历"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">order</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"小学"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"中专"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"初中"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"高中"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"大专"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"本科"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"硕士"</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"学历 vs 薪资均值"</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
<div class="nb-out"><pre class="nb-result">Text(0.5, 1.0, &#x27;学历 vs 薪资均值&#x27;)</pre><img class="nb-img" src="data:image/png;base64," loading="lazy" /></div></div>
<hr />
<h2 id="3-经验与薪资-回归分析">3. 经验与薪资 — 回归分析</h2>
<p><code>scatterplot</code> 看散点分布，<code>regplot</code> 自动添加回归线，直观判断工作年限对薪资的影响。</p>
<div class="nb-cell"><div class="codehilite lang-nb"><pre><span></span><span class="n">reset</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">fig</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subplots</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">figsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="c1"># 散点图</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">scatterplot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"经验(年)"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">alpha</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.6</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set_title</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"经验 vs 薪资 — 散点图"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># 添加回归线</span>
<span class="n">sns</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">regplot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">df_clean</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"经验(年)"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"薪资(k)"</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">scatter_kws</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"alpha"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mf">0.5</span><span class="p">},</span> 
            <span class="n">line_kws</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"color"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">"red"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"linewidth"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">},</span>
            <span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="n">axes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set_title</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"经验 vs 薪资 — 回归图"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tight_layout</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
